يمتلكا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَلِكَا (yamtalikā) /jam.ta.li.kaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# يُمْتَلَكَا (yumtalakā) /jum.ta.la.kaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
